important_information: Brinzolamide is formulated exclusively as an ophthalmic (eye drop) suspension for treating elevated intraocular pressure in glaucoma and ocular hypertension. It does not exist as an oral solid dosage form (tablet, capsule, or pill) in the United States market. Therefore, imprints, shapes, colors, sizes, and coating information are not applicable.
